environment.description: CLI tool compiled with gcc 11.4 (-O2, no ASAN) on Ubuntu 22.04, output served directly by nginx with proxy_pass to a FastCGI wrapper. No memory safety mitigations beyond default ASLR. nginx configuration passes output HTML to clients with permissive headers (default-src *). Template files are uploaded by authenticated users via a web form.

config.serving: nginx proxy_pass to fcgiwrap executing cli_parser
